text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On my day off, I notice Narita Taishin near the station. She must've just finished something, because she's heading back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hang on, isn't there supposed to be a limited-edition Animal Hunt character that spawns around here?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I might as well catch it while I have the chance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I don't see it on the radar—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Bwah?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What the—?! "Wet concrete. Please watch your step"?!

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text: Sorry, miss. I think your boot's done for. Such a shame.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Oops.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Great, now I only have one boot. How am I supposed to get home barefoot?)
choice_data_list: Taishin? Is that you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text: Oh, do you know this little lady? She stuck her foot straight into the wet concrete.

text_block_list.name: Construction Worker
text_block_list.text: Good thing your friend's here now, miss! Take care getting home!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin is bright red with embarrassment as the construction worker waves goodbye and leaves.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It's not like I need help or anything. Leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite what she says, it's clear that she'll have trouble getting back to her dorm on her own.
choice_data_list: Hang on, I'll buy you some shoes.
Hang on, I'll buy you some shoes.
Let me get you to a shoe shop. You can lean on my shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite what she says, it's clear that she'll have trouble getting back to her dorm on her own.
choice_data_list: Hang on, I'll buy you some shoes.
Hang on, I'll buy you some shoes.
Let me get you to a shoe shop. You can lean on my shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You got wax in your ears? I said I don't need your help.
choice_data_list: Should I give your dorm a call instead, then?
Should I give your dorm a call instead, then?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: N-no! That'll just make things worse!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh. Fine. Here, take this money and get me new shoes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since I got her permission, I bring her to a nearby park to wait for me, then rush to a shoe shop.

text_block_list.name: Shoe Store Employee
text_block_list.text: Young people these days love this style! They're also great to run in, so I highly recommend them!

text_block_list.name: Shoe Store Employee
text_block_list.text: And since you mentioned it earlier, these shoes go great with street fashion too!
choice_data_list: I see…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I figure I can't go wrong with shoes that have the employee's seal of approval, so I buy the pair she recommends.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, I run back to Narita Taishin and show her the new shoes.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh, thanks. You're a lifesav—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What the hell's with this cutesy nonsense?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: These aren't my style at all! You should know better!
choice_data_list: But the clerk said they go well with street fashion.
But the clerk said they go well with street fashion.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Now you're just admitting you got conned by a sales pitch. Ugh, whatever. I guess I'll put them on.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Huh… These actually don't feel so bad once you put them on.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Urgh.
choice_data_list: They look great on you, Taishin!
They look great on you, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I-I don't need your flattery. As long as they don't look weird, they're fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin seems indifferent about her new shoes, but…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, Taishin? Heading out somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Looks like you really like those new shoes of yours! ♪ They look amazing with your outfit today!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Y-you think?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah… I guess they do.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Absolutely not! I'd rather hop there on my own than lean on you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hup… Gah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin attempts to hop her way over but loses balance after a few bounds.
choice_data_list: You're going to hurt yourself! Come on, hold onto me!
You're going to hurt yourself! Come on, hold onto me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Ugh, fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She reluctantly grabs hold of my shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After walking for a while together, we come across a park and decide to rest on a bench.
choice_data_list: So, what were you doing around there?
So, what were you doing around there?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Playing a game. One of those location-based ones.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The game involves finding and capturing characters that are projected into the real world via augmented reality.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She had been trying to catch a limited-edition character when I saw her in front of the station.
choice_data_list: Maybe we'll find the character while we're walking.
Maybe we'll find the character while we're walking.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: As if it'd be that—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No way! There's a blip on the radar!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Apparently, the character she's after has actually appeared. She tells me its coordinates, which aren't too far from where we are now.
choice_data_list: It's close by. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: You gotta let off some steam after that whole shoe fiasco!
You gotta let off some steam after that whole shoe fiasco!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hm…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's not a bad way to look at it. It'd suck to go back with a bad taste in my mouth because of that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: All right. I'm definitely gonna catch it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin nods, and I lend her my shoulder again. We head off to where the character has appeared.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our teamwork pays off, and Narita Taishin manages to capture the limited-edition character.
choice_data_list: Congrats, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thanks. I guess I do feel a little better.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having finally arrived at a shop, Narita Taishin buys new shoes. She seems to be in a better mood when we part.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I feel like I've grown a little closer to Narita Taishin after working together with her.
